name: debt-2888
title: #2888 — phase 2 of the speed program: every tool computes a session's solved content once (PR, port 5174)

cases.title: 2-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves the right angle of a triangle that was drawn first and declared right-angled after (#2370)
cases.lookFor: Two green rows and a right triangle with its right-angle mark. Each press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» redraws it with the right angle at another vertex: A, then B, then back to C.
cases.before: On prod the button answers «אין תצורה אחרת — הצורה נקבעה» and the right angle stays at C.

cases.title: 2-D: the same with the triangle named («ABC ישר זווית»)
cases.lookFor: Two green rows; each press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves the right angle to another vertex.
cases.before: On prod the button answers «אין תצורה אחרת — הצורה נקבעה».

cases.title: 2-D: the one-line right triangle still cycles as it did
cases.lookFor: One green row; each press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves the right angle to another vertex.

cases.title: 2-D: the defining interaction builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The square, G on AD, the 37° angle at B; three green rows.

cases.title: 2-D: a contradicting length is still refused, with the same sentence
cases.lookFor: The third line is refused: «לא ניתן: «AB = 7» סותר את «AB = 5» …»; two rows, and the line stays in the box.

cases.title: 2-D: deleting a row and «בטל» bring back the same figure
cases.lookFor: The third row goes and comes back; three green rows at the end, D on BC.
cases.before: unchanged (a regression guard): the undo now finds the figure the session already solved.

cases.title: Analytic: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» on the slow rhombus answers at once
lines: מרחק נקודה O מהצלע DA הוא √5
cases.lookFor: Six rows. The last two lines still take several seconds each (a first solve costs what it did). Each press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» is answered at once.
cases.before: On prod each press on this figure takes 8–12 seconds.

cases.title: Analytic: «בטל» after a delete on the slow rhombus brings the row back at once
lines: מרחק נקודה O מהצלע DA הוא √5
cases.lookFor: The sixth row goes and comes back; six rows at the end. The undo is immediate.
cases.before: On prod the undo takes about 11 seconds.

cases.title: Analytic: an ordinary figure builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: A, B and the segment between them; three rows.

cases.title: Analytic: a refused line is refused again, with the same sentence, when typed a second time
cases.lookFor: «AB = 7» is refused both times: «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: «AB = 7»»; three rows, and the line stays in the box.
cases.before: unchanged (a regression guard): what the session remembers never turns a refusal into an acceptance.

cases.title: 3-D: the slow figure builds, a row turned off and on comes back, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» answers
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, S above the square with SA = 5. The third line still takes about 2 seconds (a first solve costs what it did).
cases.before: unchanged in what is drawn (a regression guard).

cases.title: 3-D: an ordinary figure builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The cube and M on the edge BB′, both rows green.

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused, with the same sentence, also when typed a second time
cases.lookFor: The claim is refused both times: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row only.

cases.title: Complex: lines, a row off and on — the same figure
cases.lookFor: Four rows and the five roots on their ring.

cases.title: Complex: a contradicting line is still refused, with the same sentence, also when typed a second time
cases.lookFor: The line is refused both times: «המשפט לא נוסף — אינו מתיישב עם: «z1 = 3+4i»»; one row.
